policy.admission: A named-aircraft performance admission needs one exact registry claim for each required capability. Each claim needs distinct primary-source and independent-validation artifacts with immutable hashes. A familiar designation, a catalog source assertion, a URL, or a model-pack evidence row does not qualify.
policy.remoteArtifact: A remote artifact hash records a retrievable identity. It does not prove that VECTOR has ingested the artifact or extracted any coefficient.
policy.localArtifact: A committed derivative fixture must hash to the registry value. A changed fixture needs a new registry version and a new review.

artifacts.scope: NASA NESC F-16 DAVE-ML verification model; not a PAF F-16C Block 52 model.
One 180-second subsonic wings-level trim trajectory; not a manoeuvre, sensor, store, or operational validation corpus.
SI-normalized NESC Case 11 checkpoints used only by the isolated public-reference verifier.
